assessments.reason: Versioned external Codex host routing and report-only investigation assets; no storefront runtime or visible state changes.
assessments.consumers: Traced .codex-autonomy Python entrypoints and JSON/workflows: loaded only by explicit native host commands and the portable test subprocess in tests/codex-routing.spec.ts. Nuxt app, Nitro routes, stores, API contracts, layouts, assets, dependency/build configuration and Playwright app configs do not import these files. Runtime helper starts a separate pinned mock checkout for evidence and changes no app source or UI data contract. Governing docs describe post-merge host installation; no installed routing code is activated. The application screenshot matrix has no changed consumer; owned-process/main smoke and focused routing tests verify the actual host effects.
